verdict.rationale: Penpot does not document a sandbox or test environment that isolates agent or API experiments from production design data. The only related evidence is self-hosting, where a user could stand up a separate instance; that is a user-side deployment workaround, not a sandbox feature, so it earns no credit. There is also no dry-run mode for MCP or API actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.
you can set up an instance of Penpot in just 3 minutes!
